name: Garnier Hair food Shampoo
description: Experience superior hydration with Garnier Ultimate Blends Nourishing Hair Food Banana & Coconut, a dual-purpose cleansing & conditioning system formulated for compromised, dry hair. This advanced blend harnesses the restorative power of banana & coconut superfood extracts to gently remove impurities & excess sebum while safeguarding your hair's natural moisture content. The result is visibly revitalized strands with enhanced softness & elasticity. Crafted without silicones & composed of 98% naturally-sourced ingredients, this vegan-certified formula delivers salon-quality performance with conscientious values. The 350ml packaging utilizes recycled plastic materials and maintains full recyclability, reflecting a commitment to both hair wellness and planetary responsibility. Achieve nourished, resilient hair without compromise.
